title: {item:tower_shield}
text:
翻出一面{item:tower_shield}：每挨一下固定减 {item_stat:tower_shield:block} 点伤害。对付出手快、每下轻的对手，几乎打不痛你；对付一锤子 {item_stat:warhammer:damage} 点的，减那 {item_stat:tower_shield:block} 点等于没减。

再搜一次。

texts.en:
You dig up a {item:tower_shield}: every hit you take is cut by a flat {item_stat:tower_shield:block}. Against a fast enemy with light hits, it barely hurts you. Against one that lands {item_stat:warhammer:damage} a swing, taking {item_stat:tower_shield:block} off is as good as nothing.

Search again.
